scope: M1 independent installed-interface demonstration using declared local contract fixtures; not module acceptance or live connections.

checks.create_read: Exact WritingService approval creates one scoped Backlog record; a separate installed CLI reads it.
checks.explicit_queue: An explicit delegated enqueue changes Backlog to Todo; creation alone never queues work.
checks.illegal_transition: Absent destination-specific delivery evidence cannot complete work.
checks.missing_human: A caller reference cannot invent human authority; installed missing human observation refuses.
checks.wrong_scope: Foreign user/session task reads and session-file substitution refuse without mutation.
checks.stale_decision: Old version or decision revision refuses without changing task state.
checks.idempotency: Same-operation retry after a lost response produces one task/effect; changed arguments conflict.
checks.missing_evidence: Missing writing approval, dependency observations and worker integration remain refused/blocked.
checks.restart: Fresh installed interpreters retain tasks, intents and idempotent operation identity.
checks.cli_mcp: Actual CLI and stdio MCP reach the same scoped application API and data.
checks.dependency_capacity: Reuse existing explicitly authored Core API controls; do not label them installed worker execution.
checks.human_hold: Reuse existing explicit human-observation API controls; missing installed producer stays pending.
